observation.visible_scene: A calm, narrow mountain lake framed by densely forested slopes on both sides under a pale blue sky with thin cirrus clouds. A single dark rock sits in the shallow foreground water, leafy shoreline vegetation occupies the left bank, and pine branches intrude at the top-right corner. The still water mirrors the right-hand slope and a bright band of sky down the center of the lake.
visible_changes: The water surface shows continuous, gentle small-amplitude ripples that shift and re-form across the lake from frame to frame, so the bright central sky-reflection and the mirrored forest on the right shimmer and slightly distort rather than staying mirror-still.

The foreground rock, the left-bank vegetation, the mountain silhouettes, and the top-right branches hold identical positions throughout, indicating a stationary camera and no object translation within the scene.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the surface ripples (e.g., wind) is not visible.
Whether this is a longer fixed shot and what, if anything, precedes or follows the crop is unknown.
uncertain_details: A tiny dark speck near the central horizon on the water appears in several frames; its identity and any motion are not clearly resolvable.
It is not determinable whether the ripple pattern is intensifying or merely oscillating, as the amplitude changes are subtle and non-monotonic across the sampled frames.
